evals.prompt: Create a .base file that shows all zettelkasten notes grouped by their `related` map, sorted by creation date descending, with a column showing days since last modified.
evals.expected_output: A valid .base file filtering for zettelkasten notes with groupBy on related, sort by create-date DESC, a days_since_modified formula, and appropriate columnSize/rowHeight settings.
expectations: File is valid YAML
Filters select zettelkasten notes using file.hasTag or file.inFolder
Has a formulas section with a days_since_modified formula using duration .days
Has a sort section with property and direction keys
Has groupBy with property: related
Includes columnSize settings for layout
Includes rowHeight setting
Formula display name is set via properties section

evals.prompt: Create a .base file for books with a cards view that displays cover images, author, and title, sorted by most recently added.
evals.expected_output: A valid .base file filtering for book notes with a cards-style view using image() function for covers, sorted by file.ctime DESC, with card layout properties.
expectations: File is valid YAML
Filters select book notes using file.hasTag('📕')
Uses image() function for cover display
View type is cards or facet-cards
Has a sort section sorting by file.ctime DESC
Includes card-specific layout properties (layout, shape, or similar)
Order includes cover image, author, and file.name

evals.prompt: Create a .base file that shows garden notes (🌱, 🌿, 🌳) with views for each maturity stage, a 'stale' view for notes not modified in 30+ days, and exclude archived notes.
evals.expected_output: A valid .base file with multiple views (one per maturity tag plus a stale view), using nested or/and filters, .contains() to exclude archive folder, inline duration comparison in stale filter, and sort by formula.
expectations: File is valid YAML
Has separate views for 🌱, 🌿, and 🌳 maturity stages
Has a stale view filtering for notes not modified in 30+ days
Stale view uses duration math like (now() - file.mtime).days > 30
Excludes archived notes using file.folder.contains('archive') or similar
Has a days_since_modified formula
Stale view sorts by days_since_modified or file.mtime
Uses nested or/and filters where appropriate
